note: Hand-authored inputs for tools/map-processor/build_map.py and tools/map-mesh/pipeline/measure_map.py. Everything here is manual-approx unless an entry states its own provenance.
zoneAnchorsNote: Pearl's valorant-api callout heights do not match the floors (median floor-minus-callout +0.68 m, MAD 1.08 m: mesh/pearl-blender-to-game-transform.json), so the mesh stage places every zone by x,y alone. Five labels do not stand on their zone's floor at all: four lie inside a building's footprint, where the only surface under the label is a roof, and B Club shares Mid Shops' x,y exactly. Each entry below names the floor object the zone was matched to and the numbers measured on the mesh (game metres, x,y,z). The zone's position keeps the callout's x,y; only its standing point (anchor) and height move.

b-club.basis: Callout (8.00, -14.50, z 4.75) has the same x,y as Mid Shops' (z 7.75): both snapped to one cell, the 10.00 m street floor at the mouth of the club tunnel (Shell_0_ClubTunnelA, y -14.7..-19.1). No floor exists 3 m under that point. The club is the room behind the tunnel: floor Shell_0_ArcadeGround at z 8.50 m under Shell_0_ArcadeRoof (x 7.6..28.0, y -31.8..-19.0), entered through Prop_0_ClubArchA (y -18.6..-19.1, base z 8.50), with Sign_0_ClubSignA / Door_0_ClubDoorB on its far wall (y -31.7, base z 8.49). Its 8.50 m floor is 597 walk cells (149 m2) on the main walk component, 1.50 m below Mid Shops' floor; centroid (15.28, -24.03), 12.2 m from the callout. Anchor = the main-walk-component cell nearest the centroid of that floor's walkable cells.
b-club.provenance: measured-on-mesh (object names, heights, floor extent, cell); manual-approx (that this named floor is the callout's zone)

mid-plaza.basis: Callout (27.50, -3.25, z 7.75) lies inside the footprint of building Shell_0_AtkMidBldA (x 25.2..33.5, y -6.5..0.0, walls z 8.00..18.56); the only surface under it is Shell_0_AtkMidBldARoof, where the zone was snapped (z 19.64 m, an island of 226 cells, 11.6 m above the plaza).
